name: prompt-input
title: Prompt Input
description: AI chat composer. The field grows as you type, files attach as chips, Enter sends and Shift+Enter breaks a line, and the send button turns into stop.

props.name: value / v-model
props.description: Text in the field. React also takes defaultValue and onValueChange. Cleared after a send.

props.name: onSend / @send / x-on:send
props.description: Fires on Enter or the send button when there is text. Blade dispatches a send DOM event with { text, files } as detail.

props.name: onStop / @stop / x-on:stop
props.description: Fires when the stop button is pressed while loading.

props.name: loading
props.description: The answer is being generated. The send button becomes a stop button and Enter no longer sends.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Character limit on the field. Shows a 12/500 counter that turns red at the limit.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Tallest the field grows, in px, before it scrolls.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Shows the attach button. Picked files appear as chips with a remove button.

props.name: accept
props.description: File types for the hidden file input, such as image/*,.pdf.

props.name: models
props.description: Options of the small native model picker on the left of the action row. Empty hides it.

props.name: model / v-model:model
props.description: Selected model. React reports changes with onModelChange, Blade fires the native change event.

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra tools after the model picker, such as search or reasoning toggles. Blade and Vue use the actions slot.

props.name: sendLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the send button.

props.name: stopLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the button while loading.

props.name: attachLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the attach button.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of each chip's remove button. {name} becomes the file name.

props.name: modelLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the model picker.

a11y: The field is a native textarea named by inputLabel, with a native maxlength. The whole box shows the focus ring while the field has focus.
Enter sends and Shift+Enter inserts a new line. Enter is ignored while an IME is composing.
The send button is disabled until there is text. While loading it stays enabled and is named by stopLabel.
The file input is hidden and opened by the attach button. Each chip has a remove button named with the file name, and removing one moves focus back to the field.

ai.whenToUse: The message box of an AI assistant, chatbot, or support chat where people write prompts and attach files.
rules: Set loading while the answer streams and stop the request in onStop
Keep the model list short, two to four options
Put it at the bottom of the conversation, below a ChatMessage log
Translate every label prop when the page is not in English

id.description: Kotak tulis chat AI. Kolom tumbuh saat mengetik, berkas terlampir sebagai chip, Enter mengirim, Shift+Enter baris baru, tombol kirim berubah jadi stop.

props.value / v-model: Teks di kolom. React juga menerima defaultValue dan onValueChange. Dikosongkan setelah mengirim.
props.onSend / @send / x-on:send: Dipicu oleh Enter atau tombol kirim saat ada teks. Blade mengirim event DOM send dengan { text, files } sebagai detail.
props.onStop / @stop / x-on:stop: Dipicu saat tombol stop ditekan ketika loading.
props.loading: Jawaban sedang dibuat. Tombol kirim menjadi tombol stop dan Enter tidak lagi mengirim.
props.maxLength: Batas karakter kolom. Menampilkan penghitung 12/500 yang memerah saat mencapai batas.
props.maxHeight: Tinggi maksimum kolom dalam px sebelum bisa digulir.
props.attachments: Menampilkan tombol lampiran. Berkas terpilih tampil sebagai chip dengan tombol hapus.
props.accept: Jenis berkas untuk input file tersembunyi, misalnya image/*,.pdf.
props.models: Pilihan pemilih model native kecil di kiri baris aksi. Kosong menyembunyikannya.
props.model / v-model:model: Model terpilih. React melaporkan perubahan lewat onModelChange, Blade memicu event change native.
props.actions: Alat tambahan setelah pemilih model, misalnya toggle pencarian atau penalaran. Blade dan Vue memakai slot actions.
props.placeholderLabel: Placeholder kolom. Default "Ask anything", isi misalnya "Tanya apa saja".
props.inputLabel: Nama aksesibel kolom. Default "Message", isi misalnya "Pesan".
props.sendLabel: Nama aksesibel tombol kirim. Default "Send", isi misalnya "Kirim".
props.stopLabel: Nama aksesibel tombol saat loading. Default "Stop", isi misalnya "Hentikan".
props.attachLabel: Nama aksesibel tombol lampiran. Default "Attach files", isi misalnya "Lampirkan berkas".
props.removeLabel: Nama aksesibel tombol hapus tiap chip. {name} diganti nama berkas. Default "Remove {name}".

a11y: Kolom adalah textarea native bernama inputLabel dengan maxlength native. Seluruh kotak menampilkan cincin fokus saat kolom difokus.
Enter mengirim dan Shift+Enter menyisipkan baris baru. Enter diabaikan selama IME sedang menyusun huruf.
Tombol kirim nonaktif sampai ada teks. Saat loading tombol tetap aktif dan bernama stopLabel.
Input file tersembunyi dan dibuka oleh tombol lampiran. Setiap chip punya tombol hapus yang menyebut nama berkas, dan menghapus memindahkan fokus kembali ke kolom.

ai.whenToUse: Kotak pesan asisten AI, chatbot, atau chat dukungan tempat orang menulis prompt dan melampirkan berkas.
rules: Set loading selama jawaban mengalir dan hentikan permintaan di onStop
Jaga daftar model tetap pendek, dua sampai empat pilihan
Letakkan di bawah percakapan, di bawah log ChatMessage
Terjemahkan semua prop label bila halaman tidak berbahasa Inggris
